composition_basis: A hexameter poem in two parts, the Way of Truth and the Way of Opinion, surviving in quotations. Diogenes Laertius 9.23 puts Parmenides's floruit in the 69th Olympiad (504-501); the range runs from there to the end of his plausible life.

composition_basis: Two opening sentences survive, of Truth and of On the Gods, both quoted by Diogenes Laertius 9.51. DL 9.56 puts Protagoras's floruit in the 84th Olympiad (444-441); the range brackets his known working life. No source dates either book.

composition_basis: Democritus wrote a large body of work, catalogued in tetralogies by Thrasyllus (Diogenes Laertius 9.45), of which only quotations and doxographic summaries survive. composition_basis: The stone counts its intervals back from its own present, and every count in this batch is used only as an interval, never as an absolute year, because the epoch archon-year was NOT established in this session from the text read. INTERNAL EVIDENCE OF LATE LAYERS: 徠民第十五, on 商君書/卷四 (read at zh.wikisource.org page 商君書/卷四 (revision 1741809, fetched whole via action=raw on 2026-10-04, this session)), refers to the victory of Changping (且周軍之勝，華軍之勝，長平之勝，秦所亡民者幾何), dated by Shiji 15 to the line labelled 260 (四十七。白起破趙長平，殺卒四十五萬。), seventy-eight years after Shang Yang's death. The Han imperial catalogue (Hanshu 30, read at zh.wikisource.org page 漢書/卷030 (revision 7908197, fetched whole via action=raw on 2026-10-04, this session)) lists it, from the collation under Emperor Cheng (至成帝時，以書頗散亡，使謁者陳農求遺書於天下。詔光祿大夫劉向校經傳諸子詩賦); 孝成建始元年 stands at the line labelled 32 on Shiji 22's labels. The received text is the 指海 edition on wikisource (Textquality 50%), 26 chapter titles of which two are lost; the Han catalogue counted 商君二十九篇.

title_en: Gongyang Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals
composition_basis: WRITTEN DOWN IN THE HAN, on the only account read this session. The index note to 春秋公羊傳註疏 (read at zh.wikisource.org page 春秋公羊傳註疏 (revision 2186386, fetched whole via action=raw on 2026-10-04, this session); Siku-entry form, source not named on the page) quotes the Tang subcommentary of Xu Yan citing Dai Hong's preface: 徐彥《疏》引戴宏《序》曰：『子夏傳與公羊髙，髙傳與其子平，平傳與其子地，地傳與其子敢，敢傳與其子壽。至漢景帝時，壽乃與齊人胡母子都著於竹帛。 — an oral transmission from Zixia's pupil Gongyang Gao through four generations of his family, set down in writing by Gongyang Shou and Humu Zidu under Emperor Jing — and itself concludes 知《傳》確爲壽撰，而胡母子都助成之。 Emperor Jing's reign is -156/-141 on the labels of the Shiji 22 edition (孝景元年 at the line labelled 156; 正月甲子，孝景皇帝崩。 at 141), read at zh.wikisource.org page 史記/卷022 (revision 2607038, fetched whole via action=raw on 2026-10-04, this session). THIN: Dai Hong (Eastern Han) via Xu Yan (Tang) via a Qing note; the oral prehistory is the tradition's and is not dated here. The work's own index page (春秋公羊傳, revision 2651835) attributes it to Gongyang Gao by tradition (傳爲戰國齊人公羊髙作).
